WITH _base AS (
  SELECT
    monthly.region AS `monthly___region`,
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `monthly___ordered_at`
  FROM monthly AS monthly
  WHERE
    (
      monthly.ordered_at >= '2024-02-01 00:00:00'
      AND monthly.ordered_at < '2024-04-01 00:00:00'
    )
  GROUP BY
    monthly.region,
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH)
), _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `ordered_at`,
    CAST(SUM(monthly.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`
  FROM monthly AS monthly
  WHERE
    (
      monthly.ordered_at >= '2024-02-01 00:00:00'
      AND monthly.ordered_at < '2024-04-01 00:00:00'
    )
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH)
), base AS (
  SELECT
    _base.`monthly___region`,
    _base.`monthly___ordered_at`,
    _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at.`amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at` AS `monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`
  FROM _base
  LEFT JOIN _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at
    ON _base.`monthly___ordered_at` IS NOT DISTINCT FROM _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at.`ordered_at`
), shifted_t AS (
  SELECT
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `ordered_at`,
    CAST(SUM(monthly.amount) AS FLOAT64) AS `amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`
  FROM monthly AS monthly
  GROUP BY
    DATE_TRUNC(monthly.ordered_at, MONTH)
), sjoin_t AS (
  SELECT
    base.`monthly___region`,
    base.`monthly___ordered_at`,
    base.`monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`,
    shifted_t.`amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at` AS `t`
  FROM base
  LEFT JOIN shifted_t
    ON DATETIME_ADD(CAST(base.`monthly___ordered_at` AS DATETIME), INTERVAL -1 MONTH) IS NOT DISTINCT FROM CAST(shifted_t.`ordered_at` AS DATETIME)
)
SELECT
  `monthly___region`,
  `monthly___ordered_at`,
  `t`
FROM (
  SELECT
    `monthly___region`,
    `monthly___ordered_at`,
    `monthly___amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at`,
    `t`
  FROM sjoin_t
) AS _outer
ORDER BY
  `monthly___region` ASC NULLS LAST,
  `monthly___ordered_at` ASC NULLS LAST

        AND _cm_monthly__amount_sum_partition_by_ordered_at.[ordered_at] IS NULL
      )
    )

    _stage_inner.`monthly___region` AS `region`,

  FROM (

  ) AS _stage_inner

  SELECT
    s1.region AS `s1___region`,
    DATE_TRUNC(s1.ordered_at, MONTH) AS `s1___ordered_at`,
    SUM(s1.rev) AS `s1___rev_sum`
  FROM __slayer_stage_s1 AS s1
  WHERE
    (
      s1.ordered_at >= '2024-02-01 00:00:00' AND s1.ordered_at < '2024-04-01 00:00:00'
    )
  GROUP BY
